evidence.contract: Offline generation of a standards-compliant RFC 5545 ICS calendar from operator-supplied JSON on stdin. `semester.start_date` is the week-1 Monday; an occurrence lands on `start_date + (week - 1) * 7 + day_offset` (Monday=0 .. Sunday=6), so the date is computed, not asserted. `parity` (all/odd/even) filters weeks; occurrences that fall past the semester end (`start_date + weeks*7 - 1`) are dropped rather than rejected. Output is CRLF-terminated with 75-octet line folding on UTF-8 character boundaries, RFC 5545 text escaping, and per-event UID/DTSTAMP/DTSTART/DTEND/SUMMARY plus optional LOCATION. No network access, no writes, no campus contact.
